# goslop text fixture — soft validation outcome assigns error/valid/warnings
# from the exception without re-raising (Project_Parva rulelang validate_date)
lang: python
file: rulelang_service.py
---
def validate_date(args):
    try:
        year, month, day = parse_bs(args["date"])
        value = {"valid": True, "date": args["date"]}
        warnings = []
    except Exception as exc:
        value = {"valid": False, "error": str(exc)}
        warnings = [str(exc)]
        reason_codes = ["INVALID_INPUT"]
        confidence = "unsupported"
        fact_ids = []
    return value, warnings
